heading: AI work across fields
intro: Agentic systems that build their own workforce — a master agent decomposes a goal, sequences its own plan of dependent subtasks, then bootstraps and deploys purpose-built worker agents for each one, with self-evaluation feeding back into which models get used.

badges.title: Agentic Systems & Planning
points: A master agent breaks a goal into its own sequenced plan of dependent subtasks
Builds and deploys a purpose-built worker per subtask — own role, tools, MCP access
Self-evaluation scores each response and steers future model choice
Rooted in MSc heuristic search and PDDL planning

badges.title: Provider Orchestration & Resilience
points: Fallback chain across Claude, Gemini and Ollama on errors, rate limits or bad keys
Correction-prompt retry on malformed output before failing over
Parallel multi-provider ensembles, with every fallback logged

badges.title: Local-First & Privacy
points: Local LLM as fallback or default, keeping sensitive data off the cloud
Fully local agent bootstrapping and chat via Ollama for private development
Local model picks backed by measured pass rates, not assumptions

badges.title: Structured Output & Prompt Discipline
points: Typed, schema-validated outputs from reusable, per-task-tuned prompts
Concrete JSON examples in prompts — an exact target, not a field list
Generated tool code compile-checked before it ever runs

badges.title: Retrieval & Grounding
points: Semantic search over my own data, chunked and pre-fetched as needed
Past successful runs retrieved as few-shot examples for new agents
Live context such as weather and news injected at generation time
